description: Editorial product hypotheses, not measured demand or medical recommendations.

projects.name: Psychotherapie-Evidenznavigator
projects.red_ocean: Research search and meta-analysis tools already exist.
projects.blue_ocean_hypothesis: German, professionally reviewed explanations integrated into training and counselling workflows.
projects.monetization_hypothesis: Team access or institution-funded information service; no treatment guarantees.
projects.go_gate: Compatible rights, deduplication and expert review.
projects.stop_condition: Business model requires automated personal treatment recommendations or unqualified therapy rankings.

projects.name: Hypnose-Forschungs- und Studienradar
functions: Separate experiments, clinical trials and reviews
projects.red_ocean: Scientific search and trial registries are established.
projects.blue_ocean_hypothesis: Small topic-specific, German-language evidence monitoring for education providers.
projects.monetization_hypothesis: Professionally curated reports and training-institute access.
projects.go_gate: Confirm registry reuse, topic counts and relevant article licenses.
projects.stop_condition: Provider directory or efficacy promises inferred from study registrations.

projects.name: Forschungsdaten- und Materialfinder Psychotherapie
functions: Filter by data type, language, rights and sharing level
Display raw-data access versus metadata-only access
projects.red_ocean: General repositories and psychology search portals exist.
projects.blue_ocean_hypothesis: A rights-aware index tailored to teaching and reproducible psychotherapy research.
projects.monetization_hypothesis: Institutional integration and curated research assistance.
projects.go_gate: Enough relevant licensed material and demonstrated retrieval advantage.
projects.stop_condition: Restricted-use files would have to be mirrored as open content.
